description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_BecomingAParent" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SocialSecurityNotification" name="Social Security notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyNotification" name="Company notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyInformation" name="Company information"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start planning maternity leave"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential models"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Select a maternity leave model"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify both participants"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time" messageRef="Message_SocialSecurityNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify Company in time" messageRef="Message_CompanyNotification"/>

      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Decide whether to extend maternity leave"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extension decision"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExtensionSelected" name="Extension selected"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtension" name="Maternity leave ends as planned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Fetch" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fetch_Select" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Collect" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_NotifySplit" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySplit_SocialSecurity" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySplit_Company" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyJoin_GatherInformation" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GatherInformation_LeaveEnds" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveEnds_Decide" sourceRef="Event_LeavePeriodEnds" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionSelected" name="Extend" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ExtensionSelected">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtension" name="Do not extend" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtension">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">not extensionChosen</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
